panel-002.alt: HOGIRL prepares for her first study abroad.

captions.text:
Twenty-six.
My first study abroad.
My first time in Europe.

panel-003.alt: HOGIRL creates a presentation on a laptop.

captions.text:
I made an
eight-slide presentation.

Where. What.
And for how long.

And what life as a chocolatier
could look like.

panel-006.alt: HOGIRL faces her family across a table.

panel-007.alt: A family member folds his arms as HOGIRL waits.

captions.text: NO.

panel-008.alt: HOGIRL's younger brothers raise their hands.

captions.text:
Where are you going, sis?
I wanna study abroad too!!

Mom!
Me too!! Me too!!
Ugh…

panel-009.alt: An outstretched hand gives HOGIRL permission to go.

captions.text: Go.
Do what you want to do.

panel-010.alt: HOGIRL looks up with a cup in her hands.

captions.text:
I’ll take care of it.
Don’t worry. Just go.
Really?
I’ll work hard.

And I’m not getting
a part-time job there.

It wasn't an opportunity that came easily.
So I wanted to make the most of every moment.

To see. To taste.
To learn. To go.

panel-014.alt: HOGIRL travels through the airport and boards a plane.

captions.text: Ladies and gentlemen, this is flight KE907 bound for London Heathrow Airport.
ENGLAND.

My first time in Europe felt unfamiliar.
Everything fascinated me.

panel-017.alt: HOGIRL rides a red double-decker bus.

captions.text: The first hurdle.
THE LANGUAGE SCORE.

panel-018.alt: HOGIRL arrives at a new home in Oxford.

captions.text: A new town. A new home.
OXFORD.

panel-019.alt: HOGIRL heads to school and boards a bus.

captions.text:
With my school bag on,
I got on a red
double-decker bus.

But where do you go
every Friday night?

KINGS
COLLEGE
NEXT — NIGHT BUS UNIVERSITY
